note: Provolone, prosciutto, olive and roasted pepper skewers with Italian bread and oil

steps.text: Cut the provolone into cubes.
Thread onto toothpicks with folded prosciutto, an olive and a strip of roasted capsicum.
Pile onto a board with sliced Italian bread and a small bowl of olive oil for dipping.

note: Beer-battered fried flathead with cabbage and lime crema in corn tortillas

steps.text: Whisk the flour with cold lager to a light batter.
Mix the sour cream with lime juice for a crema.
Dip the fish strips and fry at 180C in batches until crisp.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with cabbage, fish, crema and salsa.

note: Salami, provolone, warm olives, artichokes, roasted peppers and Italian bread

steps.text: Fold the salami and provolone onto a big board.
Warm the olives gently in olive oil and spoon over.
Add the artichoke hearts and strips of roasted capsicum.
Tear the bread for mopping up the oil.

note: Seared rump steak pieces in garlic butter, on toothpicks with horseradish

steps.text: Season the steak.
Sear hard in a very hot pan.
Rest, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Toss in melted butter with crushed garlic and sea salt.
Serve on toothpicks with a small bowl of horseradish.

note: Toasted baguette with whipped lemon ricotta and salami

ingredients.item: olive oil, plus extra to finish
salt and cracked black pepper, to taste

steps.text: Slice the baguette into 16 thin rounds and brush with olive oil.
Toast at 200C until golden.
Whip the ricotta with lemon zest, salt and a drizzle of olive oil until smooth.
Spread on the toasts and top each with a folded slice of salami.
Finish with a sliver of pickled onion, cracked pepper and parsley leaves.

note: Thick white bread fried golden in beef dripping with salt and pepper

steps.text: Heat the dripping in a heavy pan.
Fry the bread slowly until golden and crisp on both sides.
Drain and sprinkle with flaky salt and cracked pepper.

note: Thin-sliced roast beef, barbecue mayo and American cheese on slider buns

steps.text: Roast the beef at 200C until 52C in the centre.
Rest the beef, then slice paper thin.
Mix the barbecue sauce with mayonnaise.
Pile the beef into the buns with the sauce and a slice of cheese.

note: Bread bowl baked with cream cheese, sour cream, bacon and cheddar dip

steps.text: Fry the bacon until crisp.
Hollow out the cob loaf, keeping the lid.
Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, bacon, cheddar and soup mix.
Fill the loaf and wrap in foil.
Bake at 180C.
Tear the hollowed bread into chunks for dipping.

note: Crispy baked wings in hot sauce butter with blue cheese dip

dish.make_ahead: Dry the wings the day before

steps.text: Leave the wings uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the wings through.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream for the dip.
Serve with celery sticks.

note: Bacon-wrapped cocktail franks in mini rolls with pinto beans, tomato and jalapeño salsa

steps.text: Dice the tomato and onion and warm the pinto beans.
Wrap the franks in bacon.
Griddle until crisp.
Tuck into the rolls with beans, tomato, onion, mustard and salsa.

note: Baked potato skins filled with bacon and cheddar, topped with sour cream

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins with melted butter.
Fry the bacon and fill the skins with bacon and cheddar.
Bake again until the cheese melts.
Top with sour cream and chives.

note: Fennel pork sausage rolls in puff pastry, brushed with egg

dish.make_ahead: Assemble a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Mix the sausage mince with onion, fennel, breadcrumbs and pepper.
Halve the pastry sheets, lay a log of filling along each strip and roll up, sealing with beaten egg.
Cut each into 4, brush with egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake at 200C until golden and puffed.
Serve hot with tomato relish.

note: Hot-smoked salmon cream cheese with dill and capers on rye crispbread

steps.text: Flake the salmon.
Fold through the cream cheese with chopped dill, lemon zest and capers.
Spread thickly on rye crispbread.
Finish each with a squeeze of lemon.

note: Puff pastry crescents filled with dark chocolate, or ham and gruyere

dish.n: Paris café chocolate and ham croissants

steps.text: Cut the pastry into long triangles.
Lay a stick of chocolate, or ham and gruyere, at the wide end and roll up towards the point.
Curve into crescents and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

note: Lamb and beef meatballs with cumin and parsley, garlic yogurt to dip

steps.text: Mix the mince with crushed garlic, cumin, parsley and salt.
Roll into small balls.
Bake at 200C.
Mix the yoghurt with crushed garlic.
Spear each meatball upright on a toothpick and serve with the yoghurt.

note: Baked potato skins with cheddar and bacon, sour cream and chives

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Halve, scoop and brush with melted butter.
Fill with cheddar and bacon.
Bake again until crisp.
Top with sour cream and chives.

note: Pan-fried pork and cabbage dumplings with black vinegar and chili oil

steps.text: Mix the pork with wombok, ginger and spring onions.
Fill the wrappers and pleat.
Fry until crisp underneath.
Add water, cover and steam.
Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.

note: Boiled beef and pork dumplings tossed in butter, with sour cream

steps.text: Mix the beef, pork and onion with salt and pepper.
Fill the wrappers, fold into little hats and pinch closed.
Boil until they float, plus 3 minutes.
Toss in butter.
Serve with sour cream and chopped dill.

note: Chewy beef jerky marinated in soy, Worcestershire and garlic, oven dried

dish.make_ahead: Dry within a day of marinating, keeps 1 week airtight

steps.text: Freeze the beef for an hour.
Slice very thin across the grain.
Mix the soy, Worcestershire, pepper and crushed garlic and coat the beef.
Marinate overnight.
Lay on racks over trays.
Dry in the oven at 75C until chewy.

note: Soy ginger braised pork belly in steamed buns with pickled cucumber and peanuts

dish.make_ahead: Pork up to 2 days chilled

steps.text: Put the pork belly in a pot with soy, ginger, star anise and water.
Simmer until tender.
Slice the pork and pickle the cucumber in a little vinegar and salt.
Steam the bao buns.
Fill with pork, pickled cucumber, coriander and crushed peanuts.

note: Grilled white miso and garlic chicken thigh skewers with a soy sesame dip

steps.text: Mix the miso with crushed garlic and coat the chicken.
Marinate for an hour.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill until charred.
Mix soy, sesame oil and sliced spring onion for dipping.

note: Pan-fried pork and cabbage gyoza with soy, black vinegar and chili oil

steps.text: Salt the wombok, then squeeze it dry and mix with the pork.
Fill the wrappers and pleat.
Fry until crisp underneath.
Add water and steam.
Serve with soy, black vinegar and chilli oil.

note: Vanilla panna cotta in glasses with crushed meringue on top

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the gelatine sheets in cold water.
Warm the cream, milk, sugar and split vanilla bean.
Stir in the squeezed gelatine and pour into glasses.
Set in the fridge overnight.
Crush the meringue nests over the top like falling snow.

note: Crisp bacon in buttered soft rolls with brown sauce, wrapped to stay warm

steps.text: Fry the bacon until crisp at the edges.
Split the rolls and butter them generously.
Stuff two rashers into each roll with a good squeeze of brown sauce.
Wrap tightly in paper so they stay warm.

note: Mussels steamed in white wine, garlic and butter, with parsley and crusty bread

steps.text: Chop the eschalots and garlic.
Soften in some butter in a big pot.
Add the mussels and wine, cover and steam until open.
Toss through chopped parsley and a knob of butter.
Serve with crusty bread to mop up.

note: Pork and shrimp wontons in ginger chicken broth with bok choy

ingredients.item: grated ginger, plus slices for the broth

steps.text: Mix the pork and prawns with grated ginger and some soy.
Fill the wrappers and fold.
Simmer the stock with ginger slices and soy.
Add the wontons and cook.
Add the bok choy for the last minute and load up the bowls.

note: Avocado, edamame and lime dip with shrimp chips and cucumber sticks

steps.text: Blitz the avocado, edamame, lime juice, garlic, coriander and salt until smooth and very green.
Spoon into a bowl.
Cut the cucumber into sticks.
Serve with prawn crackers and cucumber for dipping.

note: Toast under a melted ale and mustard cheddar sauce

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in the ale.
Add the cheddar, mustard and Worcestershire and stir over low heat until thick and smooth.
Toast the sourdough.
Spread the cheese mixture thickly to the edges and grill until bubbling and browned in spots.
Cut in half and serve hot.

note: Smoked trout, cream cheese and dill on rye crispbread with pickled onion

steps.text: Flake the trout into the cream cheese with chopped dill and lemon juice.
Spread on the crispbreads.
Top with slices of pickled onion.

note: Pork and beef meatballs with allspice, served on toothpicks with cranberry sauce

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in milk.
Mix the mince with the soaked crumbs, egg, onion, allspice and salt.
Roll into 24 small balls.
Brown in butter.
Serve on toothpicks with cranberry sauce.

note: Shortcrust mince pies with orange zest and a pastry star on top

steps.text: Cut the pastry into rounds and press into a patty tin, saving offcuts for stars.
Fill with fruit mince mixed with orange zest.
Top each with a small pastry star and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 190C.
Cool a little and dust with icing sugar.

note: Mini beef pies with puff pastry tops and tomato sauce

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled, bake fresh

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil, add the mince and brown it well. Stir in the flour, then the stock, and simmer until thick. Cool completely.
Cut rounds from the shortcrust to line a patty tin and rounds from the puff for the lids. Fill the cases, top with the lids and press the edges to seal.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden. Squirt tomato sauce on top to serve.

note: Sherry sponge, raspberry jelly, custard, cream and fresh raspberries

dish.make_ahead: Best made the night before, keep chilled

steps.text: Put the sponge chunks in a trifle bowl and drizzle with the sherry.
Make up the jelly following the packet, pour it over the sponge and chill until set.
Spoon over the custard, then the whipped cream. Chill overnight so it settles.
Top with the raspberries just before serving.

note: Ham and gruyere sandwiches under creamy béchamel, grilled and cut small

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assemble and grill fresh

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook for a minute. Whisk in the milk and simmer until thick to make the bechamel.
Spread the bread with Dijon and fill with ham and some of the gruyere.
Top with bechamel and the rest of the cheese. Grill until bubbling and golden, then cut into small squares.

note: Crispy baked wings in hot butter sauce, blue cheese dip

dish.make_ahead: Wings can be dried a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and leave them uncovered in the fridge, ideally overnight. Season with salt.
Bake on a rack at 220C until crisp and golden.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the wings through it.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream for the dip. Serve with celery sticks.

note: Warm green and kalamata olives with citrus peel, garlic and fennel seed

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled and warm to serve

steps.text: Slice the garlic and peel the citrus into strips.
Warm the olives gently in the oil with the peel, garlic, chilli and fennel seeds. Tip into a bowl and serve warm with toothpicks.

note: Beef sliders with cheddar, pickles and tomato sauce on small buns

dish.make_ahead: Shape up to 4 hours ahead, cook fresh

steps.text: Shape the mince into 8 small patties and season well.
Fry for 2 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheddar to each at the end.
Split the buns and add tomato sauce and pickles. Stack the patties in, scatter sesame seeds and push a toothpick through each.

note: Blue jelly with raspberries, vanilla custard and whipped cream

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, top just before serving

steps.text: Make up the jelly following the packet. Drop a few raspberries into 4 clear cups and pour in the jelly.
Chill for 3 hours until set.
Spoon the custard over the jelly. Whip the cream to soft peaks and spoon on top.
Finish with the crushed shortbread and the rest of the raspberries just before serving.

note: Almonds roasted with olive oil, rosemary and smoked salt, with green olives

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, airtight

steps.text: Toss the almonds with the oil, rosemary and smoked salt on a tray.
Roast at 180C until fragrant. Serve warm in a bowl beside the olives.

note: Buttermilk-marinated chicken pieces fried crisp, honey for dipping

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in the buttermilk in the fridge, at least 4 hours or overnight.
Mix the flour, paprika and salt. Lift the chicken out of the buttermilk and dredge in the flour.
Fry in the oil at 180C in batches until crisp and cooked through. Drain on paper and serve hot with the honey.

note: Chocolate sponge rectangles sandwiched with marshmallow buttercream

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, airtight in the fridge

steps.text: Whisk the eggs and caster sugar until thick, then fold in the flour and cocoa.
Spread in a lined slice tin and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Cool and cut into 12 rectangles.
Beat the butter, most of the icing sugar, marshmallow fluff and vanilla until fluffy. Sandwich pairs of cake with it.
Melt the chocolate with the cream and dip the cakes in it. Let them set.
Mix the leftover icing sugar with a few drops of water and pipe a white squiggle on top.

note: Soy, honey and ginger glazed salmon cubes, baked and served on toothpicks

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Cut the salmon into bite-sized cubes. Mix the soy sauce, honey and ginger and toss the salmon through.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 200C until just cooked and sticky.
Spear on toothpicks and serve with lime wedges.

note: Lime jelly set with kiwi and green grapes, topped with whipped cream

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, top with cream to serve

steps.text: Make up the jelly following the packet. Halve most of the grapes.
Pour the jelly into clear glasses with the kiwifruit and halved grapes.
Chill for 3 hours until set.
Top with whipped cream and finish each glass with one perfect grape like a jewel.

note: Ham, cheddar and relish triangles, sliced red apples and a cone of mixed nuts

dish.n: Ham and cheddar sandwiches, apple, nuts
dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Butter the bread and fill with the ham, cheddar and relish. Cut into triangles.
Slice the apples and twist the nuts into paper cones.
Pack it all together like a lunch hidden away in a school attic.

note: Dark chocolate, marshmallow, almond and coconut chunks, chilled and smashed

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, airtight in the fridge

steps.text: Melt the chocolate. Stir in the marshmallows, almonds, biscuits and coconut.
Press into a lined tray and chill for 2 hours.
Smash into rough chunky rocks with the handle of a knife.

note: Cheese-stuffed beef sliders with American cheese melted in the middle

dish.make_ahead: Shape up to 4 hours ahead, cook fresh

steps.text: Divide the mince into 16 thin patties. Sandwich half a slice of cheese between 2 patties and pinch the edges sealed to make 8.
Griddle 4 minutes a side, then rest 2 minutes so the cheese doesn't burst.
Serve in the slider buns with pickles.

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming.
Whisk in the chocolate until frothy.
Pour into big mugs and pile marshmallows on top. Ducks fly together.

note: Crisp baked wings in honey barbecue sauce, celery and ranch on the side

dish.make_ahead: Dip up to 1 day, wings fresh

steps.text: Toss the wings with salt and bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the honey with the barbecue sauce and toss the wings through.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise and herbs into a ranch dip. Serve with celery sticks.

note: Cucumber rounds with cream cheese and smoked salmon, egg salad fingers on white bread

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled and covered

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool and peel.
Slice the cucumbers into thick rounds and top each with cream cheese, a fold of salmon and a sprig of dill.
Mash the eggs with salt and spread on the bread. Cut off the crusts and slice into fingers.

note: Warm blinis with creme fraiche, salmon roe, chives and a squeeze of lemon

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Warm the blinis in a low oven for 5 minutes.
Top each with a small spoon of creme fraiche, a little salmon roe and a few chives.
Add a tiny squeeze of lemon and lay them out in neat rows.

note: Firm lime jelly set in a ring mold and turned out wobbling

dish.make_ahead: Make the night before, turn out on the day

steps.text: Make up the jelly with a little less water than the packet says so it holds its shape.
Pour into a ring mould and chill overnight.
Dip the mould briefly in hot water and turn out wobbling onto a plate.
Fill the centre with cream and sliced kiwifruit.

note: Cherry tomato, mozzarella, salami and basil with olive oil and balsamic

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Thread tomatoes, bocconcini, folded salami and basil onto skewers.
Lay on a platter and drizzle with oil and balsamic. Season. Go go gadget skewers.

note: Puff pastry rolls with tomato paste, ham and mozzarella, sliced and baked

dish.make_ahead: Rolls up to 1 day chilled, bake fresh

steps.text: Spread the pastry with tomato paste mixed with oregano. Scatter with ham and mozzarella.
Roll each sheet up tightly and chill for 15 minutes so it slices cleanly.
Cut into 2cm rounds, lay on a lined tray and bake at 200C until golden.
Rest for a couple of minutes before serving.

film: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace (1999)
note: Yogurt and cumin lamb skewers grilled hot, drizzled with lemon tahini

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, grill fresh

steps.text: Marinate the lamb in the yoghurt, cumin, garlic and salt for an hour.
Thread onto skewers and grill hot and fast, turning.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and water until smooth and drizzle over to serve.

film: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones (2002)
note: Baked wings tossed in chili honey butter with sesame and scallion

dish.make_ahead: Wings fresh, sauce can be made ahead

steps.text: Bake the wings at 220C until crisp.
Melt the chilli sauce, honey and butter and toss the wings through.
Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion.

film: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith (2005)
note: Chicken, leek and tarragon in cream, baked in puff pastry cases

dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day, bake fresh

steps.text: Soften the leek in the butter, add the chicken and cook through.
Stir in the cream and tarragon and simmer until thick.
Spoon into the cases and bake at 200C for 10 minutes until golden and hot.

film: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
note: Grilled za'atar flatbreads with hummus, pickled turnips and olives

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Brush the flatbreads with oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar.
Grill until blistered at the edges. Cut into wedges.
Serve with hummus, pickled turnips and olives in little bowls.

film: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
note: Garlic chili lime shrimp grilled on skewers, with mango cilantro salsa

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 4 hours, grill fresh

ingredients.item: limes, one juiced and one for salsa

steps.text: Toss the prawns with the garlic, chilli and juice of 1 lime. Marinate for 20 minutes.
Dice the mango and mix with coriander and the juice of the second lime for the salsa.
Thread the prawns onto skewers and grill until pink and charred. Serve with the salsa.

note: Warm roasted almonds and cashews with rosemary and smoked salt, mixed olives

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, airtight

steps.text: Toss the nuts with the oil, rosemary and smoked salt on a tray.
Roast at 180C until fragrant. Serve warm in one bowl beside a second bowl of mixed olives.

note: Pan-fried pork and cabbage dumplings with chili oil and black vinegar

dish.make_ahead: Fill and pleat up to 1 day ahead, cook fresh

steps.text: Mix the pork with the wombok, ginger and salt.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Fry in oil until crisp underneath, add a splash of water, cover and steam for 5 minutes.
Serve with chilli oil and black vinegar.

note: Marinated salmon chunks grilled on skewers, with a dill yogurt dip

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 2 hours, grill fresh

ingredients.item: chopped dill, plus extra for the dip

steps.text: Cut the salmon into chunks and marinate in the lemon juice, dill and oil for 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 2 minutes a side.
Stir more dill and lemon through the yoghurt for a dip.

note: Pistachio panna cotta set in glasses with crushed pistachios and honey

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep chilled

ingredients.item: pistachios, plus extra crushed to serve

steps.text: Blend the pistachios with the milk until fine, then strain.
Warm the pistachio milk with the cream and sugar. Stir in the soaked gelatine until dissolved.
Pour into glasses and set overnight.
Top with crushed pistachios and a drizzle of honey.

film: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (2019)
note: Grilled sumac flatbreads with a pink beet yogurt dip and a green herb dip

dish.n: Sumac flatbreads with beet and herb dips
dish.make_ahead: Dips up to 2 days, grill breads fresh

steps.text: Roast the beetroot at 200C until tender, then cool and peel.
Blend the beetroot with the garlic and some of the yoghurt for a pink dip. Stir the herbs through more yoghurt for a green dip.
Brush the flatbreads with oil, dust with sumac and turmeric and grill until blistered. Serve with the dips and hummus.

film: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (2019)
note: Steamed ginger chicken dumplings in hot chicken stock with scallion

dish.make_ahead: Fill and pleat up to 1 day ahead, steam fresh

ingredients.item: spring onions, sliced, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the ginger, spring onion and soy.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam for 10 minutes.
Serve a few in each bowl with hot stock, more spring onion and a drizzle of chilli oil.

note: Football-shaped panko chicken pieces with a honey Dijon dipping sauce

dish.n: Panko chicken bites with honey mustard
dish.make_ahead: Crumb up to 4 hours ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Press the chicken into small oval football shapes.
Coat in flour, egg and panko.
Shallow fry until golden and cooked through.
Mix the honey with the Dijon for dipping and pile the footballs on a platter.

note: Baked wings in a sticky honey, soy and chili glaze with sesame

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Toss the wings with salt and bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the honey, soy and chilli until sticky.
Toss the wings through the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds.

note: Sponge, raspberry jelly, mango, custard and cream with gold sprinkles

dish.make_ahead: Make the night before, finish on the day

steps.text: Press the sponge cubes into a glass bowl. Make up the jelly following the packet and pour over.
Chill until set.
Layer with sliced mango, custard and whipped cream. Chill overnight.
Finish with gold sprinkles just before serving.

film: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull (2008)
note: Snapper cured in lime juice with red onion, chili and cilantro, sweet potato and corn

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the sweet potato until tender, then cool and cube.
Dice the snapper and cover with lime juice for 15 minutes.
Add the onion, chilli and coriander. Serve in small cups with the sweet potato and corn.

film: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull (2008)
note: Clear lemon jelly set with green grapes and blueberries

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the gelatine sheets in cold water.
Heat the water, sugar and lemon juice, then stir in the squeezed gelatine.
Layer the grapes and blueberries in glasses and pour over the jelly.
Set for 4 hours in the fridge.

film: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny (2023)
note: Spiced lamb kofta grilled on skewers, harissa yogurt to dip

dish.make_ahead: Mix up to 1 day ahead, grill fresh

steps.text: Mix the lamb with the onion, cumin, parsley and salt.
Shape around skewers.
Grill over high heat until charred and cooked through.
Stir the harissa through the yoghurt and serve as a dip.

film: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny (2023)
note: Baby octopus marinated in lemon and oregano, grilled hot, with capers

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 3 hours, grill fresh

ingredients.item: lemons, one juiced and one in wedges

steps.text: Marinate the octopus in the oil, lemon juice and oregano for an hour.
Grill on a very hot plate for 2 to 3 minutes until charred and just tender.
Pile onto a plate, scatter with capers and serve with lemon wedges.

note: Garlic chili lime butter shrimp grilled and piled on a platter

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 hour, grill fresh

ingredients.item: limes, one zested and the rest in wedges

steps.text: Toss the prawns with the garlic, chilli, lime zest and melted butter.
Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred.
Pile high on a platter with lime wedges.

note: Beef sausages grilled over coals, sliced with jammy onions and wholegrain mustard

dish.make_ahead: Onions up to 2 days, grill sausages fresh

steps.text: Cook the onions slowly in the oil with the sugar until jammy.
Grill the sausages over coals until blistered and cooked through.
Slice thickly, spear on toothpicks and serve with the onions and mustard.
